items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser that won't stress skin that is still recovering.
A simple ceramide moisturizer to support the skin barrier and comfort, since moisture is on the lower side.
A mineral SPF 50 to protect skin and help keep the look of marks from deepening.

response.routine_note: Please hold off on the 30% peel and any exfoliating or retinoid products, and ask your dermatologist or prescriber when your skin is ready, since it is under 6 months since isotretinoin. Use the cleanser and moisturizer morning and night, and apply the SPF every morning.
